description: This is a CMake script defining a function `compile_aidl` used for generating source code files from AIDL files during the build process. It includes documentation comments explaining the usage and parameters of the function, and the function implementation itself handles locating the `aidl` compiler, setting parameters, and executing the command to generate source files.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function to compile AIDL files into source code based on specified parameters, handling command invocation and parameter processing.
